data.long_meaning: Marjuwwah is a name derived from the Arabic root 'r-j-w', which means 'to cultivate'. It signifies a nurturer, a gardener, or someone who takes care of and fosters growth. In the spiritual context of Islam, it can be interpreted as a symbol of nurturing one's faith and cultivating one's character. The name Marjuwwah carries the meaning “Gardener, Cultivator” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Marjuwwah usually hope their child will grow to embody gardener, cultivator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
